note: TPM1 is a TWO-STEP transaction and step one writes nothing. F8 only selects positions; the valuation needs the 'Run Valuation' button on the positions screen that F8 lands on.

valuationCategory.label: Valuation Category
valuationCategory.note: MANDATORY and silently so - without it TPM1 refuses with 'Make an entry in mandatory field "Valuation Category"', no dialog raised, selection screen still looking correct. Only the status bar says so. Always 'Mid-Year Valuation with Reset' for this workspace (key 2).

testRun.label: Test Run
testRun.note: Named X_SIMULA here, not P_TEST as on TBB1/TPM44.

revalueWithoutPosting.label: Revaluate Without Posting
revalueWithoutPosting.note: Left alone. Setting it would make the run write nothing.

positionsScreen.title: Display Selected Treasury Positions for Valuation

runValuation.label: Run Valuation
runValuation.tooltip: Run the Valuation of the Displayed Treasury Positions (F8)
runValuation.note: THE write. A run that pressed only F8 on the selection screen reported PASS having valued nothing - the case asserts the run moved off this screen onto the Valuation Log.

results.note: Success is landing on 'Valuation Log' with the deal number in it. Still sitting on 'Display Selected Treasury Positions for Valuation' means nothing was valued.
